g.text: MONA's journey: from nothing to a released model
Asha, this is the real diary of your lab's first model. Every date, number and sentence below comes from MONA's own logs. Walk
After 6 hours of running, the power guard took its planned 20-minute break.
Back at work, the GPU hit 83°C and the exhaust was blowing very hot air. A
5-minute freeze, then a heat limiter: above 77°C, MONA pauses for 0.03 seconds
after each 0.18 seconds of work. At most 15% slower, much kinder to the laptop.
Loss at this moment: 3.42 (10.4 = random guessing; lower is better)
What MONA wrote then (prompt + MONA's words):
“The history of mathematics is very much in the new age of the 20th century.…”
Chat tuning: MONA learns to answer
↑↓ chapters Esc back F1 explain a word
